findings.doc_evidence: Requests wait as long as the server takes to respond, so slow servers never cause an error.
findings.reason: The change sets a default timeout of 30 seconds, which means slow servers could cause an error if they take longer than 3. The original description implied no timeout (or infinite timeout) which would not cause errors from slow servers.
findings.suggested_text: Requests wait as long as the server takes to respond, but slow servers that take longer than 30 seconds may cause an error.
